subject: social_studies
concept: Comparing major ethical frameworks: judging actions by consequences (outcome-based) versus by duty or rules (rule-based)
source_inspiration: adapted from foundational ethics frameworks, presented evenhandedly per the Education Conduct Policy — original content, not copied text

exercise.pictorial: Student matches a described judgment to whether it's reasoning from consequences or from duty/rules
exercise.abstract: Student analyzes a described ethical dilemma from both an outcome-based and a rule-based perspective

misconception_flags: treats one ethical framework as objectively correct rather than presenting both fairly

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
